message: The other night, we had a little scare when the smoke alarm went off while I was cooking. I scrambled to check everything and ended up in a family group chat with my kids who were all at home, sharing tips like "don't forget to check the oven!" and "where's the fire extinguisher?" It turned into a funny moment, but it reminded me how important it is to have an escape plan and know where all our safety gear is. Ever had a little kitchen adventure like that?
